about_the_game:
Take your paramedic career to the next level with the Bay Side Expansion, the latest DLC for Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator! Explore a brand-new district, respond to new high-stakes dispatch calls, and deal with a new catastrophic event in this intense new chapter in San Pelícano. The city needs you now more than ever.

New features:

- New district - Bellhill: A new area where you start your shift and respond to emergency scenarios.

- 3 new dispatch calls: A fun night on the beach turns into a medical emergency. A viral challenge takes a dangerous turn. When technology and reality collide, it's up to you to handle the situation.

- New catastrophic event: A high-speed police chase ends in chaos with multiple people injured on San Pelícano's iconic bridge. Assess the situation quickly, make life-saving decisions and take control of the chaotic scene before it's too late.

Get ready, turn on the siren, and tackle the toughest challenges yet in Ambulance Life: A Paramedic Simulator – Bay Side Expansion!

content_descriptors.notes:
Catastrophic events depict blood, gore and graphic injuries.
In some cases, breasts can be seen.
